comparisons.name: provider-rows-light
comparisons.description: The left end of two provider rows of Internet Accounts, Aqua: a row is 54 pt tall between 2 pt dividers. No logo or text reaches the crop, so nothing is masked. The dividers are drawn by the example with the separator colour, as a list would.

comparisons.name: provider-rows-dark
comparisons.description: The left end of two provider rows of Internet Accounts, Dark Aqua: a row is 54 pt tall between 2 pt dividers. No logo or text reaches the crop, so nothing is masked. The dividers are drawn by the example with the separator colour, as a list would.

comparisons.name: pane-icon-light
comparisons.description: The General icon and its label in the System Preferences grid, Aqua. The icon is masked: the example draws a stand-in, not the artwork. What is scored is the label, set in the fallback font off Apple platforms.

comparisons.name: pane-icon-light-frame
comparisons.description: As pane-icon-light with the label masked too: an image button draws nothing of its own, so the rest of the crop must be the plain background.

comparisons.name: rest-light
comparisons.description: An enabled and a disabled image-only button, Aqua.

pixels.note: the image, unchanged at rest (the fixture is a block of one colour)
no background or border is drawn around the image (spec: image-button, Button background, measured)
disabled: the image at half opacity over the page (spec: States, disabled, inferred)

comparisons.name: pressed-light
comparisons.description: The button held down with the mouse, Aqua.

pixels.note: the image darkened to 70% (spec: States, pressed: black at about 30%, inferred)
the disabled button does not change

comparisons.name: focus-ring-light
comparisons.description: Keyboard focus on the button, reached with Tab, Aqua.

pixels.note: ring over the page around the image bounds, measured on a text field (spec: focus-ring, sRGB; image-button, States, focused, inferred)
page just outside the 3 pt ring
the image does not change

comparisons.name: window-inactive-light
comparisons.description: The same after Tab in an inactive window, Aqua.

pixels.note: no focus ring outside the key window (spec: focus-ring, States)
the image does not change

comparisons.name: label-only-focus-light
comparisons.description: Keyboard focus on a button that has a label and no children, reached with Tab, Aqua: the ring surrounds the label.

pixels.note: ring over the page above the label, whose box starts at y 13 (spec: focus-ring, sRGB; a label-only image button is not in the spec: inferred)
page just outside the 3 pt ring
the second button is not focused: no ring

comparisons.name: label-only-empty-children-focus-light
comparisons.description: Keyboard focus on the second button, whose children render nothing, reached with two Tabs, Aqua: the empty image box takes no room and the ring surrounds the label.

pixels.note: ring over the page above the label of the button with empty children, whose box starts at y 13 (spec: focus-ring, sRGB; a label-only image button is not in the spec: inferred)
page just outside the 3 pt ring
the first button is no longer focused
